away.name: Stuart Skinner
away.news: Skinner has been inconsistent this season, as he has been for most of his career, but he is on a three-game winning streak, posting a 2.96 GAA and an .870 SV%. That said, the 28-year-old goalie has allowed three or more goals in four of his past five games (2-3-0). The Jets enter Thursday's game as +153 road underdogs against a Dallas Stars team that beat them 3-2 in overtime earlier this season, a game in which Skinner saved 35 of 38 shots (.921 SV%).

home.name: Jake Oettinger
home.news: The well-rested Stars return to action on Thursday against the Winnipeg Jets. The Stars last played on November 7th, when Oettinger saved 20 of 23 shots (.870 SV%) in a 4-3 win over the San Jose Sharks. The 27-year-old Oettinger leads the NHL with three shutouts, but he has battled some adversity lately, allowing three or more goals in four of his last five games (4-1-0). The Stars enter Thursday's game as -170 home favourites against a surging Winnipeg Jets team riding a four-game winning streak.

away.name: Joel Hofer
away.news: Hofer has been reliable on most nights, earning his share of the crease and making veteran Jordan Binnington the clear-cut backup goalie in St. Louis. The 26-year-old Hofer is coming off a solid outing, saving 29 of 31 shots (.935 SV%) in a 3-2 win over the Detroit Red Wings. He has allowed two or fewer goals in six of his last eight games (5-3-0), posting a .927 SV%. The Blues enter Thursday's game as -102 road underdogs against a Utah Mammoth team on a three-game losing streak (0-2-1).

home.name: Karel Vejmelka
home.news: While rookie Sebastian Cossa has played well at times for the Mammoth, he has lacked consistency and has failed to earn more starts despite Karel Vejmelka's ongoing struggles. Vejmelka has allowed three or more goals in six straight games (1-5-0), posting an ugly .840 SV%. In his most recent outing, the 30-year-old Czech goalie allowed three goals on 20 shots (.850 SV%) in a 4-2 loss to the Ottawa Senators. The Mammoth enter Thursday's contest as slight -108 home favourites against the St. Louis Blues, who have lost three of their past four games (1-2-1).

away.name: Ilya Sorokin
away.news: Sorokin has had an up-and-down 2026-27 season, but was outstanding in his most recent outing, saving 39 of 41 shots (.951 SV%) in a 3-2 shootout loss to the San Jose Sharks. It ended a four-game stretch where the 31-year-old Russian goalie had allowed three or more goals in four straight games (1-2-1), posting a .877 SV%. The Islanders enter Thursday's game as +108 road underdogs against a Los Angeles Kings team that has been outscored 8-2 in their past two games (0-2-0).

home.name: Darcy Kuemper
home.news: Anton Forsberg hasn't played poorly this season, but Darcy Kuemper remains the only Kings goalie with a win and will return to the crease on Thursday. That said, Kuemper struggled in his most recent outing, allowing four goals on 18 shots (.778 SV%) in a 5-2 loss to the Pittsburgh Penguins. The veteran 36-year-old goalie has a 2.98 GAA and .896 SV% in his last six games (5-1-0). The Kings enter Thursday's game as -122 home favourites against a New York Islanders team they defeated 3-2 earlier this season in a game where Kuemper saved 41 of 43 shots (.953 SV%).
